categories.zh: 笔记、知识管理与思维导图
代码开发、IDE 与编程环境
终端模拟、远程连接与容器
文件管理、搜索与云同步
效率启动、系统工具与桌面辅助

software.name: Obsidian
software.en: Local-first Markdown knowledge base with bidirectional links for notes and research.
software.zh: 基于本地 Markdown 的双链知识库与笔记工具，适合个人知识管理。

software.name: Logseq
software.en: Privacy-focused, local-first outliner with bidirectional linking.
software.zh: 本地优先、注重隐私的大纲型双链笔记工具。

software.name: AppFlowy
software.en: Open-source Notion alternative with boards, tables, and local storage.
software.zh: 开源的 Notion 替代品，支持看板、表格与本地存储。

software.name: Yuque
software.en: Cloud-based structured knowledge base and collaborative documents by Ant Group.
software.zh: 蚂蚁集团推出的云端结构化知识库与协作文档。

software.name: MarkText
software.en: Minimal open-source Markdown editor with a clean WYSIWYG experience.
software.zh: 极简、所见即所得的开源 Markdown 编辑器。

software.name: Zotero
software.en: Powerful open-source reference manager for literature and academic research.
software.zh: 强大的开源文献检索、管理与学术知识库工具。

software.name: Xmind
software.en: Classic full-featured mind mapping and brainstorming software.
software.zh: 经典全功能思维导图与头脑风暴软件。

software.name: Okular
software.en: KDE multi-format document and PDF reader.
software.zh: KDE 旗下强大的多格式通用文档与 PDF 阅读器。

software.name: Sticky Notes
software.en: Microsoft official sticky notes app for quick reminders.
software.zh: 微软官方便签工具，适合快速记录临时事项。

software.name: Visual Studio Code
software.en: Microsoft cross-platform lightweight code editor with a rich extension ecosystem.
software.zh: 微软跨平台轻量级全能代码编辑器，插件生态丰富。

software.name: Sublime Text
software.en: Classic fast text and code editor with a responsive interface.
software.zh: 启动极速、响应流畅的经典文本与代码编辑器。

software.name: Python
software.en: Official Python interpreter and runtime environment.
software.zh: 官方 Python 解释器与运行环境。

software.name: R
software.en: Open-source programming language and environment for statistical computing and graphics.
software.zh: 用于统计计算和图形展示的开源编程语言与环境。

software.name: RStudio
software.en: Posit official integrated development environment for R.
software.zh: Posit 官方出品的 R 语言集成开发环境。

software.name: Anaconda / Miniconda
software.en: Python data science environment with conda package and virtual environment management.
software.zh: Anaconda / Miniconda 附带的 Python 数据科学环境与包管理工具。

software.name: Ubuntu 24.04
software.en: Linux distribution commonly used with WSL 2 or standalone virtual machines.
software.zh: Linux 发行版，常用于 WSL 2 或独立虚拟机。

software.name: Git for Windows
software.en: Official Git command-line tools with a Bash simulation environment.
software.zh: Git 官方命令行工具与 Bash 模拟环境。

software.name: Fork
software.en: Fast, intuitive, and interactive graphical Git client.
software.zh: 快速直观、交互友好的 Git 图形化客户端。

software.name: Rebased
software.en: Standalone graphical Git client rebuilt on the IntelliJ platform.
software.zh: 基于 IntelliJ 平台核心改造的独立 Git 图形客户端。

software.name: Alacritty
software.en: GPU-accelerated cross-platform lightweight terminal emulator.
software.zh: GPU 硬件加速的跨平台轻量终端模拟器。

software.name: MobaXterm
software.en: All-in-one Windows terminal toolbox with Xserver, SSH, VNC, and RDP.
software.zh: 集成 Xserver、SSH、VNC、RDP 的 Windows 全能终端工具箱。

software.name: WinSCP
software.en: Open-source Windows SFTP, FTP, and SCP client.
software.zh: 开源 Windows SFTP / FTP / SCP 客户端。

software.name: FileZilla
software.en: Cross-platform FTP, FTPS, and SFTP client.
software.zh: 跨平台的 FTP、FTPS 和 SFTP 客户端。

software.name: Docker Desktop
software.en: Desktop tool for building, running, and managing containerized applications.
software.zh: 容器化应用的本地构建、运行与管理桌面工具。

software.name: Everything
software.en: Ultra-fast filename search tool for Windows.
software.zh: Windows 上极速的文件名搜索利器。

software.name: AnyTXT Searcher
software.en: Powerful full-text search engine for local documents.
software.zh: 强大的本地文档全文内容搜索引擎。

software.name: Files
software.en: Modern third-party Windows file manager with Fluent design.
software.zh: 采用 Fluent 现代设计的 Windows 第三方文件资源管理器。

software.name: WizTree
software.en: Fast disk space scanner with visual usage analysis.
software.zh: 快速扫描并可视化分析磁盘空间占用的工具。

software.name: AList Desktop
software.en: Desktop client for aggregating and mounting multiple cloud drives.
software.zh: AList 聚合多网盘挂载工具的桌面图形版。

software.name: Jianguoyun
software.en: Secure cloud drive with incremental sync across platforms.
software.zh: 支持增量同步与多平台的安全网盘。

software.name: Bandizip
software.en: Clean and efficient classic archive and compression tool.
software.zh: 纯净高效的经典解压缩软件。

software.name: Quicker
software.en: Global action launcher for mouse and keyboard workflows on Windows.
software.zh: 针对 Windows 鼠标/键盘操作的全局动作效率工具。

software.name: Listary
software.en: File search, action triggering, and app launching assistant.
software.zh: 专注于文件快速定位、动作触发与启动的辅助工具。

software.name: Flow Launcher
software.en: Open-source quick launcher with plugins for apps, bookmarks, and more.
software.zh: 快速启动程序、书签与插件扩展的开源快捷启动器。

software.name: Maye Nano
software.en: Minimal low-resource desktop launcher and category tool.
software.zh: 极简、低资源占用的桌面快速启动与分类工具。

software.name: PixPin
software.en: Full-featured screenshot, pin-on-screen, and offline OCR tool.
software.zh: 功能全面的长截图、贴图与离线 OCR 工具。

software.name: UniGetUI
software.en: Graphical package manager interface for WinGet, Scoop, and Chocolatey.
software.zh: 整合 WinGet、Scoop、Chocolatey 的包管理图形化界面。

software.name: Geek Uninstaller
software.en: Lightweight uninstaller that removes programs and leftover files.
software.zh: 快速、彻底清理残留的轻量级软件卸载工具。

software.name: Watt Toolkit
software.en: Game network acceleration, account switching, and script toolbox.
software.zh: 游戏平台网络加速、账号切换与脚本工具箱。

software.name: CC Switch
software.en: Configuration and switching tool for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex.
software.zh: 面向 Claude Code / Codex 等 AI 编程助手的配置与切换工具。

software.name: Catrace
software.en: Health helper that tracks typing and work status and reminds you to rest.
software.zh: 监控打字及工作状态并提醒久坐休息的健康辅助工具。

software.name: Firefox
software.en: Open-source mainstream browser from Mozilla focused on privacy.
software.zh: Mozilla 出品的开源、注重隐私保护的主流浏览器。

software.name: Zen Browser
software.en: Beautiful vertical-tab browser deeply customized from Firefox.
software.zh: 基于 Firefox 深度定制的美观垂直标签页浏览器。

software.name: Thorium
software.en: High-performance optimized Chromium-based browser.
software.zh: 基于 Chromium 构建的高性能优化分支浏览器。

software.name: Thunderbird
software.en: Cross-platform open-source email, calendar, and contacts client from Mozilla.
software.zh: Mozilla 旗下的跨平台开源邮件、日历与通讯录客户端。

software.name: Free Download Manager
software.en: Cross-platform multi-threaded download manager with torrent support.
software.zh: 跨平台的多线程下载与种子/磁力下载工具。

software.name: Stacher
software.en: Cross-platform graphical media and video downloader powered by yt-dlp.
software.zh: 基于 yt-dlp 的跨平台流媒体与视频图形下载器。

software.name: Auto Caption
software.en: Automated video speech transcription and subtitle generation tool.
software.zh: 自动化视频语音转录与字幕生成工具。

software.name: N-Studio
software.en: Screen recording and multi-track video editing tool.
software.zh: 屏幕录制与多轨道后期剪辑制作工具。

software.name: Huorong
software.en: Clean, lightweight Chinese endpoint security and antivirus software.
software.zh: 纯净、轻巧、无弹窗骚扰的国产终端安全杀毒软件。

software.name: Clash Verge Rev
software.en: Cross-platform Clash proxy graphical client built with Tauri.
software.zh: 基于 Tauri 框架的跨平台 Clash 代理图形客户端。

software.name: Stirling PDF
software.en: PDF Application on GitHub that lets you edit PDFs on any device anywhere

software.name: Outline
software.en: The fastest knowledge base for growing teams. Beautiful, realtime collaborative, feature packed, and markdown compatible.2

software.name: Caddy
software.en: Fast and extensible multi-platform HTTP/1-2-3 web server with automatic HTTPS
